why: THE COMMANDER'S GRANT IS FREE AND DOES NOT CARE WHAT ANYTHING COSTS, so the cheapest enchantment creature is the most efficient carrier of deathtouch, lifelink and hexproof. This is the hypothesis the Shrine failure pointed at: shrines-v4 and v5 both raised the curve and both lost board power at T6 (7.00 -> 6.43 / 6.66). Five one- and two-drops instead. Every one is a BUY -- the owned pool holds only three cheap enchantment creatures and all three are marginal -- so this branch is also the price check on that hypothesis.
